task.policy: skill-aware PPO with original mask v2

interpretation: The reward formulation interacts with skill availability: in skill-aware PPO the candidate accumulates longer native alive time and more boss damage with similarly heavy Bomb spending (almost nine per run), while the separately trained movement-only arm got worse under the same reward bundle. This is not evidence of better innate dodging or stage clearing. The arms differ in action capacity, and only a single training seed was used; do not compare cross-experiment estimates causally.
limitations: All 32 eval episodes lose three lives; no clears.
Original skill-action mask v2 blocks Surge early discharge.
One training seed and 16 evaluation seeds, intervals exclude training variance.
Several reward coefficients changed together; no individual identification.
Native confirmed manual item pickup and first death telemetry missing.
decision: No champion promotion; prioritize native behavioral traces and risk-conditioned movement competence before bigger training.
